segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, this is Priya Nair from Northbeam support. Just letting you know this call is being recorded.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Honestly we are frustrated. The reports have been broken for three weeks and support keeps closing our tickets.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what changed three weeks ago?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Nothing on our side. This is unacceptable for the amount we pay every month.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: We are seriously thinking about cancelling and switching to Vantora before the renewal date.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand. I'll escalate this to our support lead today and follow up by Thursday.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Fine. If the reports are not fixed by then we will end our contract.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Understood. I will send you a written incident summary tomorrow.
